name: Olives
description: Cured and brined — inedibly bitter straight off the tree.

tcm.note: The Chinese olive is a different fruit; the Mediterranean one has no classical entry.

ayurveda.note: Not classical; salt-cured and oily reads ushna.

unani.note: Zaytoon and its oil are har-ratab in Unani — warming and moistening, a standard tonic.

histamine.note: SIGHI treats unfermented olives as risky and pickled or fermented ones as worse — table olives are cured, so the curing is what rates them, not the fruit.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.
